items.quote: If you want it done well the first time, call CNC Auto Care. I have dropped my Suburban in multiple times for a lot of different care. Everytime I pick my truck up, it is better than we could have imagined it. They always pick up on other things that may cause issues down the line, they never try to fix things that are not needed and they go over the parts when the labor is all done.
items.name: Kristine Larson

items.quote: I had a leaking sunroof with flooding! They got me in same day, fixed the problem, and vacuumed all the water out. Such a relief. I also had my brakes repaired earlier this year. Good pricing and communication on both. They have my loyalty. Really appreciate you guys! Thanks Miguel!
items.name: Jacqueline

items.quote: CNC has been our go to mechanic shop for years. They are always quick to diagnose the issue. Their prices are very fair and they are up front about how much the repairs will cost. Miguel is the kindest person and gets to know his clients. All of the mechanics in the shop are very helpful and knowledgeable.
items.name: Kayla Wolfe

about.title: Specialized automotive care since 2018
paragraphs: At CNC Auto Care, we are a specialized auto repair shop offering reliable preventive and corrective services to keep your vehicle running safely and smoothly.

Established in 2018, CNC Auto Care LLC serves Vancouver, Washington, with a focus on specialized automotive care. Our journey is driven by a steady commitment to excellence and high-end technology, ensuring that every car receives precise attention and the professional mechanical repair it needs to perform at its best.

estimate.text: Tell us what your vehicle is doing and Miguel and the team will get back to you. Or text (360) 991-9676 or call (360) 448-7723, Monday to Friday 9am to 6pm and Saturday 9am to 4pm.
